walkthroughs.body_html:
Direct taxes come straight off income — like income tax and National Insurance.

Indirect taxes are added to prices — VAT, fuel duty, tobacco duty.

Big UK taxes include:

  • Income tax — on wages.
  • VAT — usually 20%.
  • Council tax — paid by households to councils.
  • Corporation tax — on company profits.

Excise duty is extra tax on petrol, alcohol and tobacco.

Two jobs:

  • Raise money.
  • Put people off using harmful things.

That's why cigarettes are so pricey. 🚬
